title: Whiter the Cherubim
description: A Polar opposite of Wither an Angel Meant to Serve God , Now Descended into the Overworld
body:
A heavenly entity that watches all directions, never turns, banishes evil to the Nether where they deserve to be and avoids violence unless you bring it down to 50% health when it enters nether itself and punishes the sinners with the Smites of Heaven and Fire of Hell 
A presence so Divine that it turns flowers into Healing Roses  
Upon Death it's Heavenly Flesh Sprouts Healing Flowers all Around You  
If attacked will banish you to Nether use Enderpearls to Save yourself before the Banish Executes
